mentions.name: dense-printer
mentions.description: A web tool that squeezes as much text content onto a printed page as possible, instead of printing 4 or more pages per sheet, so users can print long-form content to read while disconnected. The author is also exploring how to set up the site so an LLM tasked with printing content through it can use it effectively.
mentions.problem: Printing web content wastes paper, taking 4 or more pages per sheet when the goal is dense printed pages for offline reading.
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://avi-perl.github.io/dense-printer/

I tend to print a lot of stuff to read while disconnected. This is a tool to help squeeze as much content onto a printed page as possible instead of printing 4 or more pages per sheet.
mentions.author: aviperl
